## Open findings

### High (2)

- `settings-app-sidebar-tail-unreachable` — **SettingsApp** — The sticky sidebar is taller than the area it can be seen in, so its last links are unreachable — `client/settings/components/SettingsSidebar.svelte:71`
- `settings-app-unauthenticated-dead-end` — **SettingsApp** — A network failure and an expired link are both reported as "Session expired", with no way out of the page — `client/settings/session.svelte.ts:45`

### Med (7)

- `plugins-inactive-copy-overclaims-approval` — **PluginsSection** — The ineligible-plugin sentence names approval as the remedy for six different states — `client/settings/lib/plugin-eligibility.ts:44`
- `settings-app-admin-nav-not-collapsible` — **SettingsApp** — The Admin group is the longest nav list and the only one that cannot be collapsed — `client/settings/SettingsApp.svelte:145`
- `settings-app-advanced-toggle-reads-as-divider` — **SettingsApp** — The inline Advanced disclosure is styled as a horizontal rule and has no hover or active state — `client/settings/SettingsApp.svelte:292`
- `settings-app-breakpoint-keys-off-viewport` — **SettingsApp** — The layout breakpoint keys off viewport width, so the content column is narrowest just above it — `client/settings/settings.css:7`
- `settings-app-focus-ring-scoped-to-grid` — **SettingsApp** — The app's focus ring is scoped to the content grid, exempting the three most global controls — `client/settings/settings.css:132`
- `settings-app-jump-menu-bare-select` — **SettingsApp** — The only navigation below 720px is a bare native `<select>` — `client/settings/components/SettingsJumpMenu.svelte:24`
- `settings-app-loading-gate-unannounced` — **SettingsApp** — The loading gate blanks the page to a single unannounced word — `client/settings/SettingsApp.svelte:202`

### Low (6)

- `settings-app-advanced-hint-undercounts` — **SettingsApp** — The Advanced hint names five items for a group of ten — `client/settings/SettingsApp.svelte:244`
- `settings-app-duplicate-nav-labels` — **SettingsApp** — Two nav labels appear in two groups with nothing to tell them apart — `client/settings/SettingsApp.svelte:114`
- `settings-app-hardcoded-px-in-shell-chrome` — **SettingsApp** — The shell chrome is built from one-off px while the sections it frames use the spacing tokens — `client/settings/components/SettingsSidebar.svelte:64`
- `settings-app-jump-menu-ignores-collapse` — **SettingsApp** — The jump menu ignores the collapse model and cannot re-select the current section — `client/settings/components/SettingsJumpMenu.svelte:25`
- `settings-app-scrollspy-rewrites-history-entry` — **SettingsApp** — Scrollspy overwrites the history entry, so Back returns to a position that no longer matches — `client/settings/SettingsApp.svelte:194`
- `settings-app-unauthenticated-state-uncaptured` — **SettingsApp** — The expired-session state has no story and cannot be given one — `client/stories/decorators/withFixtures.ts:37`

## Deferred

- `repos-no-edit-capability` — **ReposSection** — A repository can only be added or deleted, never edited
